articles.company_name: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. Common Shares
articles.summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite is pleased to announce that it has been granted mining lease for its Matawinie Mine by Québec’s Ministry of Natural Resources and Forests.
articles.title: NMG Reaches a Major Regulatory Milestone with the Granting of the Mining Lease by Québec’s Ministry of Natural Resources and Forests for the Matawinie Mine
